title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Hugging Face
providers.scope_notes: Covers Hugging Face Hub (Team / Enterprise / Enterprise Plus). Hosted Hub; token management needs Team or Enterprise, org revoke and service accounts need Enterprise, IP ranges need Enterprise Plus. Inference Endpoints use the same user access tokens.

controls.name: Token Policy: Require administrator approval
controls.what: Fine-grained tokens need admin approval for org resources; read/write tokens are blocked.
controls.setting: Organization settings > Tokens Management > Token Policy

controls.name: Deny token
controls.what: Removes approval-based org access immediately; reversible.

controls.name: Revoke token (org)
controls.what: Permanently removes a member token's access to the org only.

controls.name: Revoke leaked token everywhere
controls.what: Anyone can submit a raw token value; matching tokens are invalidated everywhere immediately.

controls.name: Restrict organization access to your IP ranges only
controls.what: Org resources reachable only from listed CIDRs, including via tokens.

controls.name: Fine-grained token permissions
controls.what: Limit token to specific repos/orgs and actions.

controls_unknown: Admin-enforced expiry for user access tokens or service account tokens (no setting found; PATs are valid until revoked).
Whether access tokens require or bypass an SSO session under Basic or Managed SSO.
Org-level allowlist or block for third-party OAuth apps.
Org-level control over who can configure Trusted Publishers on org repos.
Exact audit event name for OAuth Token Exchange issuance (docs say exchanges are logged).
Whether IP ranges apply to OAuth, Token Exchange and Trusted Publisher tokens.

authentication.summary: hf_ token created by a user with per-resource permissions; sent as bearer token or used as git password. Also used to call private Inference Endpoints.

federation.details: Basic SSO prompts members when accessing org resources; docs do not say whether access tokens require an SSO session.

ip_restriction.boundary: Enterprise Plus 'Restrict organization access to your IP ranges only' applies to access tokens for org resources only.

renewal.summary: User can refresh (rotate) or delete from settings.

administration.summary: Team/Enterprise admins can list member tokens, require approval for fine-grained tokens touching org resources, and deny them; Enterprise admins can revoke a token's org access.
administration.conditions: Org deny/revoke only cuts off that org; token keeps working elsewhere. Admin-created tokens are auto-approved.

offboard.details: Token access to org resources follows org membership, and SCIM deprovisioning revokes the user's access; the token may still work for the user's own resources.

inventory.details: Org settings token listing and GET /api/organizations/{org}/settings/tokens list all member access tokens.

offboard.ui: Organization settings > Members > revoke membership; with SCIM, deprovision in the IdP. For immediate cut-off: revoke the token from Tokens Management
offboard.api: SCIM: set user active=false or delete the user via SCIM; POST /api/organizations/{org}/settings/tokens/{token_id}/revoke

log_sources.name: Organization Audit Logs (UI or GET /api/organizations/{org}/audit-log/export)
log_sources.notes: Team & Enterprise. Membership, settings, repo and token-approval events; anonymized IP. Retention not stated.

anomaly_cues: Token never rotated or unused for long periods in org token listing

containment.steps: Enterprise: revoke org access via API; for full kill submit the token to POST /api/credentials/revoke or have owner delete it.
containment.notes: Org revoke stops org access; credentials/revoke invalidates everywhere immediately.

unknown: Token creation/use events are not in the org audit log event list

calls.reveals: User, orgs and auth method of the token
calls.log_notes: Not among the documented audit event types
